title: Who is who in Lost Spring
back: Saheb, Mukesh, Savita, the old woman, the grandmother: each one trapped.

title: Lost Spring in six beats
back: Garbage is gold → barefoot 'tradition' → tea stall → furnaces → bangles and destiny → vicious circle and Mukesh's dream.

svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Security without freedom" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><g><path d="M160,130 V70" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M136,130 H184 L178,140 H142 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/><path d="M80,62 L240,78" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M80,62 L64,98 H96 Z M240,78 L224,114 H256 Z" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><g transform="translate(80,58)"><rect x="-17" y="-40" width="34" height="44" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none" rx="5"/><path d="M-11,-40 Q0.0,-56 11,-40" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></g><g transform="translate(240,74)"><path d="M-20,0 V-40 Q0.0,-54 20,-40 V0 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.5" stroke="none"/></g></g><text x="80" y="170" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">owner's canister</text><text x="240" y="170" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">his own bag</text><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">Security without freedom</text></svg>
back: Tea stall: 800 rupees and meals, but not his own master.

title: Shoes with a hole
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="To a barefoot boy, discarded tennis shoes are treasure" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><g transform="translate(60,130) scale(1.4)"><path d="M0,0 H60 Q70,0 70,-10 Q60,-18 40,-18 L30,-30 H6 Q0,-30 0,-20 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/><circle cx="46" cy="-8" r="5" fill="#E0B400" stroke="none"/></g><g transform="translate(170,150) scale(1.1)"><path d="M0,0 H60 Q70,0 70,-10 Q60,-18 40,-18 L30,-30 H6 Q0,-30 0,-20 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.5" stroke="none"/></g><text x="250" y="100" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.8" stroke="none">a dream</text><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">To a barefoot boy, discarded tennis shoes are treasure</text></svg>
back: Barefoot is 'tradition': perpetual poverty, seen by the author.

back: 20,000 children at the furnaces: heat, darkness, dust, blindness.

title: Bangles: joy they never know

back: Savita does not know bangles mean marriage; the old woman has no full meal.

title: The vicious circle

back: Moneylenders, middlemen, police, idle politicians; caste and destiny.

title: Few airplanes fly over Firozabad
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Mukesh's dream: a garage, not the sky" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="40" y="110" width="240" height="50" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none" rx="6"/><rect x="70" y="85" width="80" height="30" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none" rx="4"/><circle cx="90" cy="165" r="14" fill="#E0B400" stroke="none"/><circle cx="230" cy="165" r="14" fill="#E0B400" stroke="none"/><path d="M250,40 L290,30 L280,50 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.25" stroke="none"/><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">Mukesh's dream: a garage, not the sky</text></svg>
back: A garage, not the sky: small enough to be real. A flash of daring.

title: Why 'Lost Spring'?
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Line to remember" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><g><rect x="28" y="36" width="264" height="72" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.08" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" rx="10"/><path d="M50,108 L42,122 L64,108 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/><text x="160.0" y="77.25" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">stories of stolen childhood</text></g><text x="160" y="146" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.8" stroke="none">— the subtitle says it</text><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">Line to remember</text></svg>
